verdict.rationale: AnythingLLM is built as an AI assistant that users drive through natural-language chat. The evidence documents chatting with docs, using AI agents, agent web scraping and search, custom agent skills, and agent flows, so issuing natural-language commands that the agent acts on is the product's core interaction model. The evidence is mostly headline-level, though, and does not show the product's own settings or administration being operated through natural language. missing for 10: evidence that product configuration and management can be done via natural-language commands, in-depth docs on agent command invocation, independent hands-on corroboration of agent task execution.
